ns2:course.label: Veterinary Clinical Pathology
ns2:course.description: (VP 338) Discusses the function and interpretation of hematological, chemical, and certain other procedures, including exfoliative cytology, as aids in the diagnosis of animal diseases; emphasizes the correlation of laboratory findings with fundamental changes and clinical manifestations of disease. 4 professional hours. Prerequisite: Second-year standing in veterinary curriculum.
